method: Read independently projected exposed pad-top pixels at four sample positions for all120 decoded native frames per video; verify pad pixels remain >20 levels brighter than adjacent tabletop and have a warm tint >2 levels; require each tracked RGB channel range <=3 over the clip. The initial uncalibrated raw-material hue threshold was invalid under renderer color management and is preserved separately; this test uses decoded image contrast and temporal continuity. Actual bounds contact tested separately. No generator imports.
